stories.title: Bessent announces 'D-day' sanctions against Iran in 'Operation Economic Outcast'
stories.reason: Treasury expanded secondary sanctions to digital assets, technology, gold, aviation, and shipping, marking a major escalation of economic pressure on Iran.

stories.title: Canada to hit US with retaliatory tariffs as trade war escalates
stories.reason: Carney announced dollar-for-dollar retaliation on US steel, dairy, appliances, and electronics starting September 8 after trade talks collapsed.

stories.title: Firefighters make progress holding wildfire in Reno area, where 87K have been urged to evacuate
stories.reason: The uncontained Hawk Fire has forced roughly 90,000 evacuations and closed hospital facilities near the University of Nevada, Reno.

stories.title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq slip as Bessent announces 'economic asphyxiation' campaign against Iran
stories.reason: Markets are digesting both the new Iran sanctions and the US-Canada tariff escalation in the same session.

stories.title: Google's Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
stories.reason: Gemini reached the milestone faster than ChatGPT did, becoming Google's fastest-growing product ever.

stories.title: Nvidia stock tumbles again, pacing for seventh-straight drop ahead of earnings
stories.reason: Investor anxiety is building ahead of Wednesday's earnings call, which will move valuations across the entire AI trade.

stories.title: EU begins enforcing AI Act, putting AI models under the microscope
stories.reason: New transparency rules now require chatbots to disclose themselves and deepfakes to carry labels, with fines up to €15 million for violations.
